reasons: Both answers meet all four rubric items with nearly identical structure: they say no, explain that the timeout meant the outcome was unknown, recommend idempotency keys, a state machine and reconciliation, and describe the missed-payment downside of the teammate's fix. B's example result is internally inconsistent: it marks an unknown outcome as "safe_to_retry": true and in the same breath tells the agent not to call again until it has reconciled. B also puts the unique constraint on invoice_id alone, which would block a legitimate re-payment after a definite failure. A keeps retry_safe false for unknown outcomes and keys the constraint on invoice plus approval version, so it is a bit more careful, while B's explicit bottom line for the teammate is a small point in its favour.
